messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGED oncall-amber for billing-metering anomaly in eu1. Alerts: token_count_delta > 15% over 5m, delayed emitter heartbeat. Link: https://ops.redwood/incident/4820193701
oncall-amber: I'm on it. grabbing initial dashboard and logs now. priority: customer-impact check + stop noisy overage flags.
sre-luis: seeing token delta between shadow and primary pipelines. shadow counts stable, primary +18% at 11:22 UTC. suspect emitter reorder + retry amplification. snippet from emitter logs: ```WARN emitter/retry.go: attempt=4 id=em-7e4 xyz token_emit=1200 -> duplicate_ack```
billing-qa: confirming — several accounts got auto-overage flags; flags triggered by the primary tally not shadow. we can bulk-suppress alerts but need safe guard so we don't miss real spikes.
eng-runtime: checking KV cache + prefixing path. recent deploy 4820189000 changed batching window to 50ms; reverting that patch to staging now. if batching change caused dedupe miss, that could explain extra tokens.
oncall-amber: @billing-qa please prepare temporary suppression policy: mute automated overage notifications for 10m on eu1 while we triage. cs-rita loop in on high-touch customers and hold any billing notices.
cs-rita: copying ops. I'll DM top 7 affected customers with a note: short delay in usage reporting, we are investigating — no final charges will be posted until resolved. prepping template now. :thumbsup:
pm-jordan: need impact summary for execs: brief bullet points of who affected, ETA for fix, whether invoices will be touched.
sre-luis: mitigation plan: 1) toggle emitter retry cap to prevent amplification (done, 11:28 UTC) 2) switch primary tally to shadow-safe mode (route counts through shadow reconciler) 3) kick off backfill job for missing/deduped events. starting step 1 & 2 now.
billing-qa: suppression in place for eu1 overage alerts at 11:30 UTC. we will still record raw counts for audit.
eng-runtime: rolled back batching change on a staging shard, smoke passed. prepping prod rollback if step-2 reconciliation doesn't stabilize within 5m.
oncall-amber: customer-impact assessment: ~120 accounts triggered soft-overage flags, 9 got automated emails. cs-rita will send conciliatory note and hold billing. ETA for reconciliation/backfill: ~45-90m depending on backfill throughput.
sre-luis: latest: primary delta down to +3% at 11:36 UTC after retry cap. starting backfill job (job id: bf-482019). will monitor token_lag and reconcile_rate.
pm-jordan: thx — please prepare short post-incident note + tentative timeline. keep me posted every 30m or on significant state changes.
oncall-amber: oncall handing off to sre-luis for overnight monitoring at 12:00 UTC. I'll remain on standby for comms. tagging incident-bot to update status. :white_check_mark:
